title: INTEL 40G Fiber Module E40GQSFPSR Ethernet QSFP+ SR4 Optical Module

items.h: Transmission Distance: Up to 100m on OM3 / 150m on OM4

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Intel E40GQSFPSR 40G QSFP+ SR4 Optical Module is a high-performance, multi-mode fiber (MMF) transceiver designed for 40GbE short-range data center connectivity. Operating over 850nm wavelength and supporting up to 100 meters on OM3 and 150 meters on OM4, this Intel QSFP+ module delivers reliable and energy-efficient 40Gbps performance for high-density switching environments.


With an MTP/MPO connector interface and full compliance with IEEE 802.3ba 40GBASE-SR4, the Intel E40GQSFPSR ensures seamless compatibility with major networking switches, servers, and storage systems. Its low power consumption and stable optical output make it ideal for modern cloud infrastructure, virtualization environments, and enterprise networks.


Get the Intel E40GQSFPSR 40G QSFP+ SR4 module from D CORE for original, dependable, and high-speed fiber optic connectivity.
